text:
sara.sales: ApertureCare RFP landed. They want a capability matrix + security questionnaire answers + a concise on-prem POC plan (4-week). Key asks: dedicated capacity, customer-managed KMS/HSM, EU data residency (eu-west-1). PDF attached in thread.

mike-se: Copy. Do we have expected qps or avg token lengths? Need to size dedicated pool and call out perf tradeoffs for air-gapped.

sara.sales: They noted ~180 concurrent sessions peak, typical prompt ~80 tokens, responses ~220 tokens. Target latency: p50 <= 250ms, p95 <= 650ms.

mike-se: Baseline recommendation: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for steady load, autoscale to 3-4 for 2x spike buffer. For air-gapped appliance plan we'll call out a higher-spec target and note p95 risk.

anya-ops: Clarify deployment expectations: do they want our private control plane in their VPC or a self-contained appliance image? They checked "air-gapped optional."

sara.sales: They want both options documented. Provide two POC tracks: 1) Private VPC deployment (managed control plane w/ customer network), 2) On-prem air-gapped appliance (image + offline install guide).

mike-se: I'll prepare a capability matrix that contrasts hosted/dedicated/private/air-gapped with throughput and SLOs. Also include connector notes for customer KMS and HSM.

deploy-bot: Template check: SOC2-TypeII=yes, ISO27001=partial, FedRAMP=no, KMS-integration=yes, HSM-attestation=partner-certs-available. See /sales/rfps/templates.

chris-csm: We should lock acceptance criteria now: is success measured by throughput, latency, or integration with their KMS + audit log export? Need explicit pass/fail for the 4-week window.

dylan-legal: We'll need DPA + addendum for air-gapped deployment and responsibilities for key custody. Also confirm if they require subprocessor disclosures. I'll draft a redline.

anya-ops: For teardown: include an explicit data destruction checklist, signed verification, and optional forensic snapshot for their audit. For air-gapped: include USB transfer checksums, signed manifests, and manual key injection steps.

mike-se: Draft matrix CSV (for inclusion) below — numbers conservative vs hosted.

```
component,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,airgapped
concurrent-sessions,800,2500,220,220
p50-latency,100ms,85ms,140ms,210ms
p95-latency,420ms,290ms,580ms,820ms
kms-mode,managed,customer-managed,connector,hsm-offline
data-residency,global,region-pinned,region-pinned,onsite-only
rollout-time,minutes,minutes,hours,days
```

sara.sales: Good start. Mike, expand this into the RFP matrix and a 2-page POC runbook for both tracks (install steps, smoke tests, perf test script). Anya, add teardown + SHA256 manifest template. Dylan, attach DPA draft. I'll schedule kickoff with their infra on Wed 09:00 UTC.

mike-se: ETA tomorrow EOD for matrix + runbook. Note: if they insist on p95 < 500ms for air-gapped with current model config, we'll need to propose a beefier instance spec or relaxed p95 target. I'll call this out in the response.

anya-ops: Flag: FIPS-only image requirement will add ~10 business days to build and security review. Also network egress restrictions may prevent auto-updates; include manual patch guidance.

chris-csm: I'll confirm acceptance criteria and whether they want a sample integration with their auth layer + KMS during the POC.

dylan-legal: Sending initial DPA redline in thread. We'll add a clause for customer-managed HSM responsibilities and a data destruction attestation.

sara.sales: Uploaded ApertureCare_RFP_v1.pdf and their security questionnaire (ApertureCare_SecQ_v1.pdf). Please review before the kickoff. Call invite sent. Thanks. :v:

mike-se: One last note 
 if they require measurement of per-token cost during POC we should include simple billing hooks and a sample billing report template.

anya-ops: Agreed. I'll add a short sample billing/export and the teardown verification signature block.

sara.sales: Great. We'll reconvene after the kickoff to finalize attachments.
